verdict.line: You win if you press the lane and solo-kill Ornn before level 10; you lose if the game drags and his Living Forge gold lets him out-scale you into a Brittle-knockup kill.

brief.thesis: Yorick holds the lane and solo-kill edge here, but the 43% head-to-head win rate over 790 games exists because Ornn's kit answers Yorick's two core tools directly: W (Bellows Breath) applies Brittle to blow up anyone who overstays, and his E (Searing Charge) collapses Yorick's W (Dark Procession) wall almost immediately if he's near terrain. The matchup rewards closing the lane fast and punishes drawn-out skirmishes where his passive gold lets him out-build you.

theirWindow.what: He can charge into any terrain near your W wall and knock everyone up, chaining into R for a kill combo. Don't trade or wall him when he's standing within E range of a wall or cliff.

yourWindow.what: This is your only safe window to trap him with W (Dark Procession), since he has no way to break the wall or knock you up. Land E (Mourning Mist) first to mark him, then wall and swing empowered Q autos.

powerCurve.note: Q sustain autos win early trades
Living Forge gold snowballs his stats

start.why: Carries a 47.4% win rate over 272 games against a magic-damage laner, beating Doran's Shield's 38.9% here since Ornn's Q/W/E/R all hit for magic.

boots.why: 43.8% win rate over 404 games; the tenacity cuts the duration of his Q slow and R knockup chain, and the magic resist softens his full magic-damage kit.

core.why: Opens the 46.8%-win, highest-sampled core path; the damage proc and move speed let you punish before his items come online.
Shreds the bonus armor his Living Forge passive grants, which otherwise makes him unexpectedly tanky for a mage.
Cooldown reduction keeps Q (Last Rites) and E (Mourning Mist) cycling faster so you can out-trade him between his ability windows.

situational.when: the lane stalls and you need to out-scale through split pushing and waveclear
he's stacking armor fast through Living Forge and you need the penetration plus slow
you want a shield and burst window to force all-ins before his R is up

runes.keystoneWhy: The 43.2%-win page; sustained autos in extended trades heal you back while his Brittle only punishes burst, not grind, so Grasp wins the war of attrition.

summoners.why: The 44.8%-win combo beats Flash+Teleport's 42.3% here; Ignite secures the solo kills your lane advantage is built around before his R comes online.

playing.title: Trade with empowered Q autos early
playing.detail: Levels 1-3, use Q (Last Rites) on cooldown (6s at rank 1) to win short trades; Ornn has no Brittle threat yet so every exchange favors your sustain.

playing.title: Mark before you wall
playing.detail: Throw E (Mourning Mist) to slow and armor-shred him first, then drop W (Dark Procession) only when his E (Searing Charge) is on cooldown so the wall actually holds.

playing.title: Never wall him near terrain
playing.detail: If he's within 450 range of a cliff or wall edge, skip the W trap entirely; Searing Charge breaks it and knocks you up in the same motion.

playing.title: All-in before level 10
playing.detail: Your solo-kill advantage is real but shrinks fast once his Living Forge gold starts buying him bonus armor and MR; force fights while you're still ahead on stats.

playing.title: Respect R once he hits 6
playing.detail: Call of the Forge God has a 140s cooldown at rank 1, so track it after each cast; don't sit at half health in lane once it's up.

playing.title: Push waves into grave plays
playing.detail: Use Q's grave mechanic on minions to build Mist Walkers before contesting him, since the extra bodies win skirmishes once he's past the early solo-kill window.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/sample numbers above are measured from live games on the current patch (16.19.1); the mechanical reasoning and trade timing are my own analysis.

stats.opponentTip: Ornn is a difficult opponent as his (W) can get rid of [P] easily, while [W] can be destroyed with (E) quickly. He can also use (R) to kill you if you did not manage your health properly. Use [E] to contest lane and try to trap him with [W] only when (E) is on cooldown.
